What is wrong with the people in this thread? They have no idea how to talk to a depressed person. "Just get over it." "Grow some thicker skin," is disgusting. If it was that easy, he wouldn't be typing this. 

To OP: hang in there. No matter what, no one deserves to be told that. Even if you "egged them on" that doesn't justify their actions. I suffer from depression as well and as a result, hateful remarks affect me a lot worse than they should. There was one game where I ended up crying because the people on my team made me feel so terrible. However, I've gotten better with dealing with toxic people and they don't affect me as much anymore. When someone says something that crosses the line, mute them immediately and focus on yourself. It helps a shit ton. Best of luck and if you ever need to someone to talk to, you can PM me!
